title: Risk factors for endothelial cell loss after Descemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty (DMEK)
indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy; triple DMEK (with phacoemulsification and IOL) in 358 of 644 organ-culture and 106 of 197 cold-culture eyes, otherwise DMEK alone in pseudophakic eyes; phakic DMEK, primary graft failures, previous glaucoma surgery or vitrectomy excluded; first eye only

groups.description: Standard Cologne DMEK (injector, descemetorhexis, air or 20% SF6) with organ-cultured donor tissue (DMEM with fetal calf serum at 37 C, dextran before transplantation); donors from German or US eye banks; two surgeons; consecutive cases 2011-2016 from a prospective database
Same DMEK technique with cold-stored donor tissue (Optisol-GS at 5 C)

series.baseline_label: Baseline ECD (Table 2) = donor ECD evaluated before storage (Methods; donor information from the supplying eye banks)
series.notes: Table 2 'Organ culture' column, rows Baseline ECD and ECD 1, 3, 6 and 12 months after surgery, with per-visit n in the cell text; postoperative ECD by Tomey EM-3000 specular microscopy.

series.baseline_label: Baseline ECD (Table 2) = donor ECD evaluated before storage (Methods; donor information from the supplying eye banks)
series.notes: Table 2 'Cold culture' column, rows Baseline ECD and ECD 1, 3, 6 and 12 months after surgery, with per-visit n in the cell text.

exclusions.what: Table 2 row 'ECD loss rates at 12 months (%)' and Figure 1 loss rates
exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for each group; the absolute ECD series is used

exclusions.what: Whole-cohort ECD course in the Results text
exclusions.reason: Pooled over both groups and not in a table; the per-group Table 2 series are used

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA, CCT, re-bubbling and rejection rows; Table 3
exclusions.reason: Not endothelial cell density; model statistics are not admissible

notes: Role: organ culture and cold storage are two standard donor storage methods compared without an investigational agent; both control-role, separate groups.
Primary graft failures were excluded from the study population (Methods); follow-up n varies by visit (Table 2).
Table 2 labels the dispersion 'mean ± SD', but it is small relative to the whole-cohort SDs given in the Results text and may be a standard error; dispersion is not used in the record.
